rule:
Selection of the fixed hidden episode set (a maintainer's tool; the grader never runs it). The rule, fixed before any candidate was drawn (it is also in the pull request's pre-registration): 1. Freeze. The grader's episode loop and world (tests/remote_grade.py, tests/episodes.py, tests/remote_env.py, tests/grader_config.json), the launcher and the numerics fingerprint (tests/nonet_exec.py, tests/numerics_check.py, tests/numerics.json), the room's files' pin (environment/assets.sha256) and the reference (solution/solver/*.py, solution/solve.sh) are committed first: `draw` refuses to start while any of them differs from the checkout's HEAD and records their sha256 and the commit; `run` and `make` refuse to go on when any of them differs from the recorded hashes. 2. Draw. `draw` takes the set's key from os.urandom(32) (hex) and writes it to the record before any candidate runs. Place p's candidate i (i = 0, 1, 2, ...) has the 64-bit seed int.from_bytes(blake2b(b"candidate|

|", key=key, digest_size=8).digest(), "little"). 3. Composition. 12 episodes: two per place for under the settee, under the chest, under the hat, in the basket and loose in a drawer; one under each seat pad (the two pads are one place). 4. Run. Candidates i = 0..BATCH-1 of every place, then the next BATCH of a place that is still short, up to MAX_CANDIDATES. A candidate in which more than HIDDEN_PIXELS pixels of the TV remote show in either camera at the start is rejected unplayed. Otherwise the privileged reference plays it three times over the real wire (remote_grade.run_episodes with that one episode and the oracle submission as solution/solve.sh lays it out, given the token truth; the probe lock at the grader's rate with a fresh OS-entropy stream per run), stopping at the first run that is not kept. 5. Keep. A candidate is kept when each of the three wire runs scores 1.0 within STEP_MARGIN of the step cap (so no graded episode needs the reference to use more than 60 % of its steps). Per place the first kept candidates in candidate order are the place's episodes. Every candidate tried is recorded: kept, or rejected with its runs. 6. Void. If a place is short after MAX_CANDIDATES, the draw is void: `draw --void REASON` records why and draws a new key; the record keeps every draw. A frozen file that changes after a draw voids it too (`draw --void REASON --refreeze`). 7. Order. `make` shuffles the 12 (places in the order of PLAN, a place's episodes in candidate order; a Fisher-Yates in which position i swaps with int.from_bytes(blake2b(b"order|", key=key, digest_size=8).digest(), "little") mod (i + 1), i from 11 down to 1) and writes tests/hidden/episodes.json in that order: the graded order.
